title: Diversity-Aware Ensemble of Quantum-Classical Models via Combinatorial Fusion
abstract: arXiv:2610.13808v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Variational quantum circuits (VQCs) are highly sensitive to circuit architecture, yet most quantum machine learning pipelines select a single best design and discard the remaining candidates. This paper addresses whether the structural diversity across quantum circuit search spaces can be used to produce stronger predictions through model fusion. We apply Combinatorial Fusion Analysis (CFA), a model fusion framework that selects and combines multiple scoring systems using rank-score function (RSF) and cognitive diversity (CD), to a pool of 29 architecturally diverse classical models and quantum circuits. Using a diversity-aware model selection method, we identify subsets of maximally diverse models and combine them with both score and rank combination. translated_title: 基于组合融合的多样性感知量子-经典模型集成
translated_abstract: 变分量子电路（VQC）对电路架构高度敏感，然而大多数量子机器学习流程仅选择单一最佳设计并丢弃其余候选方案。本文研究了一个问题：量子电路搜索空间中的结构多样性是否可以通过模型融合来产生更强的预测。我们应用组合融合分析（CFA）——一个利用秩-得分函数（RSF）和认知多样性（CD）来选择和组合多个评分系统的模型融合框架——对一个包含29个架构各异的经典模型和量子电路的模型池进行处理。通过一种多样性感知的模型选择方法，我们识别出具有最大多样性的模型子集，并结合得分组合与秩组合两种方式对它们进行融合。在涵盖不同领域的四个二分类基准数据集上的实验表明，基于CFA的混合经典-量子融合方法持续优于最佳的单个模型。
tldr: 本文提出基于组合融合分析（CFA）的多样性感知方法，通过秩-得分函数和认知多样性将多个架构各异的量子电路与经典模型进行融合集成，在四个二分类基准上持续超越最佳单一模型。
en_tdlr: This paper applies Combinatorial Fusion Analysis (CFA) with rank-score functions and cognitive diversity to ensemble architecturally diverse quantum circuits and classical models, demonstrating that diversity-aware hybrid fusion consistently outperforms the best individual model on four binary classification benchmarks.
